name: Do you replace door handles on all types of doors, including exterior and interior doors?

mainEntity.name: Do you replace door handles on all types of doors, including exterior and interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as general contractors, we are equipped to replace door handles on all types of doors, including standard interior doors for bedrooms and bathrooms, as well as more robust exterior entry doors. This includes various materials such as wood, fiberglass, and metal doors. Our service ensures the correct handle type and function are installed for both security and aesthetic purposes, meeting the specific requirements for each door's location and usage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we replace door handles on all types of doors, including interior and exterior, and various materials like wood, fiberglass, and metal.
